_note: Error@v1 in the wire. Every BFF error carries extensions.code from a CLOSED set — the frontend switches on `code`, shows extensions.user_message[locale], and never parses `message`. This example is the stock-depletion case at add-to-cart / checkout.

errors.message: Not enough stock for this item.

user_message.de: Nicht genügend Lagerbestand für diesen Artikel.
user_message.en: Not enough stock for this item.
